note: Adapted from Emerson’s 1952 original English description; the alate was described by Silvestri, and Emerson 1952 could not borrow specimens for verification, so only the soldier is listed here; measurements translated verbatim from Table 17 of the original, in millimetres, the sample being only 2—3 individuals. The original did not describe the worker.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldier small, right mandible length from the notch proportionally short; lateral margins of the labrum rounded, sides of the postmentum nearly parallel. C. snyderi has more curved sides of the head, more angular lateral margins of the labrum and a longer anterior part of the right mandible; C. cumulans has distinctly more angular lateral margins of the labrum and a proportionally narrower middle of the postmentum.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head, pronotum and abdomen pale yellow. Upper surface of the head sparsely covered with many long setae and somewhat shorter hairs, but not forming a contrasting short hair blanket; postmentum with many short hairs; pronotum with setae and short hairs on the anterior margin; tergites with setae; sternites with setae and hairs. Head nearly rectangular, sides slightly curved and nearly parallel, posterior angles rounded, posterior margin curved; frontal tube proportionally rather large. Postmentum rather wide, sides nearly parallel, at its narrowest about 3/4 of the greatest width. Antennae 15-segmented. Lateral margins of the labrum rounded, white median lobe slightly projecting. Left mandible with a sharp notch, 1 small tooth behind the notch, small serrations behind the tooth, no distinct serrations in front of the notch; right mandibular notch deep, forming an angle of less than a right angle. Anterior margin of the pronotum not concave or very weakly concave. Measurements (mm; original Table 17, n=2—3): head length including mandibles 2.60—2.70 (mean 2.65); head length to the tip of the frontal tube 1.83—1.94 (1.90); head length to the lateral mandibular bases 2.00—2.07 (2.03); head width 1.40—1.46 (1.43); head thickness 1.09—1.12 (1.10); frontal tube length 0.33—0.36 (0.34); labrum width 0.51—0.53 (0.52); left mandible length 0.96—1.00 (0.97); right mandible length from the notch 0.50—0.53 (0.51); pronotum length 0.49—0.50 (0.49); pronotum width 0.76—0.81 (0.79); hind tibia length 1.27—1.41 (1.34).
